newsitem.title: USA: Pharmacia wins patent ruling vs PerSeptive.
newsitem.headline: Pharmacia wins patent ruling vs PerSeptive.

text.p: Pharmacia Biotech said Thursday that a court ruled in its favor and against PerSeptive Biosystems Inc involving patents for "perfusion chromatography," a specialized method of separating and purifying molecules in the biotechnology industry.

The company said the U.S. District Court for the District of Massachusetts ruled against PerSeptive Biosystems Inc, saying PerSeptive failed to demonstrate that it did not intentionally fail to credit all those involved in its patents for the technique.

"Today's decision removes any question about Pharmacia Biotech's right to continue developing and marketing its own proprietary technology, which is sold under the Source and Resource product names," Pharmacia said in a release.
PerSeptive general counsel Samuel Hunt said his company would appeal the case.
"This case is hardly far from over. We are going to appeal this case to the U.S. patent court of appeals. We think the court is plainly wrong," Hunt said.
